description: Search UK legislation by title words (and optional year), returning matching Acts/instruments with their full-text URLs. UK legislation only. Source: legislation.gov.uk Atom feed. Document types: ukpga (UK Public General Acts), uksi (UK Statutory Instruments), asp (Scottish Parliament Acts), anaw/asc (Wales), nia (Northern Ireland), ukla (UK Local Acts). "type" is optional: give an exact code (e.g. "ukpga"), a plain category ("act", "si", "ssi"), or omit it entirely — omitted defaults to "ukpga" and the response says so.

title.description: Words to match in the title, e.g. "equality".

type.description: Document type code (e.g. "ukpga") or category ("act", "si", "ssi"). Optional — defaults to "ukpga" if omitted. Full code list: ukpga (UK Public General Acts), uksi (UK Statutory Instruments), asp (Scottish Parliament Acts), anaw/asc (Wales), nia (Northern Ireland), ukla (UK Local Acts).

year.description: Optional year to restrict results, e.g. 2010.

name: search_uk_legislation
title: Search Uk Legislation
